idea: App marketplace for booking cleaners, beauticians, plumbers and other home-service pros
lesson: Homejoy shut in 2015 amid worker-classification lawsuits and weak repeat bookings, while Urban Company trained and certified its own pros, standardised pricing and listed in India in 2025.

idea: Groceries and essentials delivered in 10-30 minutes from dark stores
lesson: Kozmo (2001), Europe's Gorillas and Getir and LatAm's JOKR burned out on delivery costs in low-density or high-wage cities, while Zepto and Blinkit made 10-minute dark stores work in dense Indian cities with cheap riders and high order frequency.

idea: Dockless app-unlocked shared bicycles parked anywhere
lesson: The bikes were nearly identical; ofo, Bluegogo and Wukong died in China's 2017-18 subsidy war, while Mobike sold to Meituan for about $2.7B and Hellobike survived with Ant Financial backing.

idea: App-based ride hailing with independent drivers
lesson: Uber sold its China arm to Didi in 2016 and its Southeast Asia arm to Grab in 2018, and Korea's Tada was legislated out in 2020: local champions with local payments, vehicle types and regulator relationships won their home markets.

idea: Daily group-buying deals on local restaurants and services
lesson: Daily deals faded in the US (Groupon, LivingSocial) and ended in Korea's 2024 TMON/WeMakePrice payment collapse, while Meituan won China's 'thousand-group war' and turned deals into high-frequency food delivery and local services.

idea: Online supermarket with its own warehouses delivering scheduled grocery orders
lesson: Webvan died in 2001 building warehouses ahead of demand, and later inventory-led grocers lived or died on order density and access to capital: BigBasket sold to Tata in 2021, while Missfresh, Honestbee and Merqueo ran out of money.

idea: Members-only flash sales of discounted branded fashion and home goods
lesson: US flash-sale sites Gilt and Fab.com were sold for a fraction of peak value once the excess-inventory boom ended, while Vipshop became a profitable listed retailer clearing brand stock in China's fragmented apparel market.

idea: On-demand delivery of anything from local stores
lesson: Delivering 'anything' worked where it grew into a super-app with food and payments density (Rappi, Glovo, Postmates' sale to Uber), while Dunzo, squeezed by better-funded quick-commerce rivals, collapsed in 2024-25.

idea: App-only consumer bank with no branches
lesson: Nubank won Brazil by attacking a concentrated, high-fee banking market with a free credit card, while Australia's fully licensed Xinja and Volt could not raise follow-on capital in an already competitive market and handed back deposits in 2020 and 2022.

idea: Buy now, pay later instalments at online and in-store checkout
lesson: Afterpay sold to Block for about US$29B in 2022 after winning early, while later entrants Openpay (2023), Laybuy (2024) and India's ZestMoney failed once interest rates and regulation tightened.

idea: Buy and sell inspected used cars online with delivery and financing
lesson: Inventory-heavy online car retailers in the US and UK (Beepi, Shift, Vroom, Cazoo) collapsed when capital got expensive, while Kavak and Cars24 became unicorns in markets where low-trust informal dealing left more room for a certified retailer.

idea: Online test prep, tutoring and K-12 learning apps
lesson: The pandemic edtech boom ended in collapse for Byju's, 2U, Lido and Zenius and in China's 2021 ban on for-profit tutoring, while PhysicsWallah, built on low-price YouTube teaching, listed in India in 2025.

idea: Peer-to-peer marketplace matching individual lenders with borrowers
lesson: China's P2P sector was wiped out after Ezubao's Ponzi collapse and a regulatory purge, and Indonesia revoked Investree's licence in 2024, while LendingClub survived by becoming a bank and Lufax exited P2P before the crackdown.

idea: Restaurant food-delivery marketplace with its own rider fleet
lesson: Food delivery consolidated to one or two winners per market: Zomato and Swiggy absorbed India's field (TinyOwl and Foodpanda India sold or shut), Meituan out-scaled Alibaba's Ele.me, iFood dominates Brazil and Baemin dominates Korea.

idea: B2B app supplying inventory and credit to small corner shops (kiranas, warungs, tiendas, dukas)
lesson: Supplying small shops is thin-margin and capital-hungry: Frubana and Ula shut and Twiga shrank when funding dried up, while Udaan survived only by raising repeatedly and cutting categories.

idea: Lease office space long, fit it out, and rent desks short as flexible coworking
lesson: WeWork went bankrupt in 2023 on long fixed leases and China's Ucommune shrank after its 2020 listing, while India's Awfis listed in 2024 by relying on landlord-funded, revenue-share 'managed aggregation' deals.

idea: Shared dockless e-scooters and e-bikes rented by the minute
lesson: Bird went bankrupt in 2023 and Latin America's Grin/Grow collapsed in 2020, while Lime reached profitability and India's Yulu survived by renting low-speed e-bikes to delivery riders.

idea: Branded network of standardised budget hotel rooms booked through one app
lesson: OYO outlasted India's budget-hotel aggregator war while Zo Rooms and Stayzilla shut, and in Indonesia Airy closed in 2020 while RedDoorz kept operating.

idea: Short-form mobile video app
lesson: Twitter shut Vine in 2017 and premium short-form Quibi died in 2020, while Musical.ly, ByteDance's TikTok (merged 2018) and Kuaishou won with algorithmic feeds and creator tools.

idea: Furnished managed rental rooms and coliving for young renters
lesson: China's Danke Apartment listed in New York in 2020 and collapsed within months on a model where tenants' rent loans funded expansion, and India's Nestaway was sold in a fire sale, while Ziroom and Stanza Living kept operating.

idea: New electric-car maker building its own vehicles
lesson: Byton, WM Motor, HiPhi and Jiyue died like Fisker and Canoo in the US, while Nio, Li Auto and Xpeng survived China's EV price war by reaching volume and landing state or strategic capital in time.

idea: Electric scooter maker selling direct to consumers
lesson: Ather's slower, product-first build kept gaining share, while Ola Electric's subsidy-fuelled rush lost market share and most of its value after its 2024 listing.

idea: Network of stations that swap depleted EV batteries for charged ones
lesson: Better Place went bankrupt in 2013 trying to standardise car batteries, while Gogoro made swapping work with small, standard scooter batteries in dense Taiwanese cities.

idea: Rent cars from private owners or a self-drive fleet by the hour through an app
lesson: Turo became the US leader in peer-to-peer car rental, while Getaround exited the US in 2025 and India's Zoomcar lost most of its value after a 2023 SPAC listing.

idea: Delivery-only kitchens running virtual restaurant brands
lesson: Delivery-only kitchen landlords like Kitchen United closed or shrank, while Rebel Foods survived in India by owning its own food brands (Faasos, Behrouz) on top of Zomato and Swiggy demand.

idea: Retail crypto exchange app
lesson: FTX and QuadrigaCX collapsed through fraud, Zipmex froze withdrawals in 2022 and WazirX lost about $230M to a 2024 hack, while Coinbase listed in 2021 and Bitso grew into Latin America's largest exchange.

idea: Daily morning subscription delivery of milk and staples
lesson: Doodhwala ran out of money in 2019 and Swiggy shut Supr Daily in 2022, while Country Delight won by owning dairy sourcing and the brand, not just the morning delivery.

idea: Online-first furniture and home decor brand or marketplace
lesson: Made.com (UK) and Fabelio (Indonesia) collapsed in 2022, while Wayfair, Pepperfry and Castlery kept operating, the latter two adding physical showrooms.

idea: Cheap products sold through social sharing and group buying to value shoppers
lesson: Pinduoduo and Meesho won by pairing social sharing with very low prices and low seller fees for shoppers in smaller towns, while DealShare and Brazil's Facily shrank sharply after 2022.

idea: National messaging or social app built to beat a global incumbent
lesson: Hike and Koo died fighting WhatsApp and Twitter/X head-on, while Kakao and LINE won because they reached Korea and Japan before WhatsApp and built payments and services on top.

idea: Real-money fantasy sports and skill gaming app
lesson: DraftKings and FanDuel grew as US states legalised betting, while India's 2025 Online Gaming Act banned real-money games and wiped out Dream11's and MPL's core business overnight.

idea: Online travel agency selling flights, hotels and packages
lesson: MakeMyTrip, Despegar and Traveloka survived as booking agents, while Brazil's 123milhas went bankrupt in 2023 (and Hurb fell into crisis) after selling flexible-date trips paid upfront and betting that future fares would fall.

idea: Buy produce directly from farmers and sell it to businesses, cutting out middlemen
lesson: Farm-to-business produce platforms are fragile: TaniHub in Indonesia and Otipy in India shut, while India's DeHaat and Ninjacart kept raising and operating by adding farm inputs, credit and B2B trading.

idea: Online property listings portal for buying and renting homes
lesson: Zillow won US listings with free traffic monetised through agent ads, Housing.com burned heavily on marketing and was sold to PropTiger in 2017, and NoBroker grew in India by cutting out brokers with paid subscriptions.
